name: A long turn and the quiet after it go through their tiers
case: Claude works on one turn for twelve minutes, then sits idle for ten. The board hears how long in its tags, the last tier reached: tier1 from 30 seconds of work, tier2 from a minute, tier3 from 2, tier4 from 5 and tier5 from 10; then, once the turn is over, the same ladder again from when it came to rest.
why: Core.when: the working stretch's tier (Occasions.tiers, from Core.stretch's start) and, with none working, the time since the last turn ended, the last tier reached in state.when (characters/CHARACTER.md §9)
